headline: Christmas Bucket List
tagline: Plan the cozy, check off the magic

scenes.title: Vintage Icon Bucket List
tips: Cross off pictures as you go
scenes.say: Hang this on the fridge so even non-readers can cross off the little pictures.

scenes.title: Classic Categories Checklist
scenes.say: Pick one cozy night in and one outing each weekend, so December never feels rushed.

scenes.title: Classic Tradition Stars
tips: Color a star when it's done
scenes.say: Let the kids color in a star each time you finish a tradition together.

scenes.title: Watercolor Winter Bingo
tips: Try for five in a row
scenes.say: Turn the season into a game. Five in a row earns an extra cup of cocoa.

scenes.title: Couples Holiday Date List
scenes.say: Fill in cozy nights in and festive outings together, then circle each date you enjoy.

scenes.title: 12 Ornament Coloring List
scenes.say: Write one idea inside each bauble, then shade it in when you've done it.

scenes.title: Gingerbread Category List
scenes.say: Fill this in together over hot cocoa, with everyone adding one tradition to each section.

tips.title: Before you print
items: Many come in color and B&W
tips.say: Print it before December starts, and grab the black and white version to save ink.

say.title: Free printable Christmas bucket lists to plan your coziest holiday season yet.
say.hook: Pick your traditions and tick them off all December.
say.end: Download them all free at printamoo dot com.
